profile.summary: Vanguard Music and Performing Arts is a nonprofit performing arts education and youth development organization based in Santa Clara, California. It runs the Santa Clara Vanguard drum and bugle corps, the Vanguard Cadets, winter percussion and winter guard programs, and community music education programs.
